title: CausalPFN: Amortized Causal Effect Estimation via In-Context Learning
authors: Vahid Balazadeh, Hamidreza Kamkari, Valentin Thomas, Benson Li, Junwei Ma, Jesse C. Cresswell, Rahul G. Krishnan
venue_status: NeurIPS 2025 main conference; venue record independently verified
specific_claims: Learns CEPO posteriors under an identifiable, ignorability-based prior; evaluates both treatment-effect accuracy and uplift.
context_mechanism: For large tables: weak-CATE sorting and contiguous context windows for query batches.
label_compute_budgets: Default K4096; marketing K50000; causal pretraining context2048.
limitations: Authors conjecture retrieval explains full-table underperformance; this is not established causation.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: mandatory native-retrieval baseline, beyond random and feature-kNN.

title: Do-PFN: In-Context Learning for Causal Effect Estimation
authors: Jake Robertson, Arik Reuter, Siyuan Guo, Noah Hollmann, Frank Hutter, Bernhard Schölkopf
venue_status: NeurIPS 2025 main conference; supersedes earlier workshop version
specific_claims: Predicts CID and derives CATE; prior averages over potentially nonidentified SCMs.
context_mechanism: Observational rows; treatment in first feature column.
label_compute_budgets: Context10–2200; pretraining48/96 hours, RTX2080.
limitations: Official README documents continuous X/Y and binary treatment.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: binary rare-outcome uplift extends documented scope.
evidence_sections: Sections 2–4.4; Appendix C; README line9 at pinned revision

title: Foundation Models for Causal Inference via Prior-Data Fitted Networks
authors: Yuchen Ma, Dennis Frauen, Emil Javurek, Stefan Feuerriegel
specific_claims: Constructs setting-specific SCM priors and models for back-door, IV, and front-door estimation.
context_mechanism: Observed support rows; query treatment/outcome masked; GMM causal-target head.
label_compute_budgets: Sequence1024, support80%; approximately24 hours on one A100.
limitations: Identification-compatible prior matters; checked experiments do not establish fixed-budget uplift-policy gains.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: important alternative causal backbone; changing context cannot fix unidentified targets.
evidence_sections: Sections 3–6; Appendix A.1, D.2, E.3, E.7

title: Causal Foundation Models
authors: Christopher Stith, Hossein Rahmani, Jesse C. Cresswell
specific_claims: Explains CFMs and compares three released models with classical estimators on RealCause-Lalonde.
context_mechanism: Observed dataset as context; no new retrieval algorithm.
label_compute_budgets: Ten realizations; CPU runtime includes classical fitting/tuning but excludes CFM pretraining.
limitations: PEHE/ATE evidence concerns semi-synthetic earnings, not binary-event marketing targeting.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: useful taxonomy and contrary evidence against universal CFM superiority.

title: A Foundation Model for Policy In-Context Longitudinal Causal Effect Estimation
authors: Wenxin Chen, Kyra Gan, Mingyu Lu, Zilin Jing, Fei Wang, Hoifung Poon, Tristan Naumann, Peniel Argaw
specific_claims: Amortizes CAPO estimation for dynamic longitudinal treatment policies.
context_mechanism: Factual trajectories plus history–target-policy-action demonstrations; not learned support-row retrieval.
label_compute_budgets: Synthetic rollout supervision; frozen deployment; context-size sensitivity tested.
limitations: Sequential ignorability/positivity required; factual MIMIC prediction is not counterfactual validation.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: policy-conditioned context is already prior art; top-decile context selection remains a different problem.

title: Causal Longitudinal Prior-Fitted Networks for Counterfactual Outcome Prediction
authors: Amirhossein Zare, Amirhessam Zare, Herlock Rahimi, Reza Salarikia, Mohammad Kashkooli
specific_claims: Frozen support-conditioned prediction under planned longitudinal treatment sequences; recursive one-step rollout.
context_mechanism: Support trajectories, query history, proposed future actions; temporal SCM pretraining.
label_compute_budgets: Prior support3–500 trajectories; benchmarks vary40–500.
limitations: Static planned sequences differ from dynamic policies; factual ICU forecasting cannot verify intervention effects.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: longitudinal support memory is established, but not per-query uplift retrieval.
evidence_sections: Section2.2; Table4; AppendicesB–C, H; code availability

title: Causal Foundation Models with Continuous Treatments
authors: Christopher Stith, Medha Barath, Vahid Balazadeh, Jesse C. Cresswell, Rahul G. Krishnan
venue_status: Preprint; model named CCPFN; workshop mention not independently venue-verified
specific_claims: Estimates individual treatment-response curves with a separate continuous-treatment encoder.
context_mechanism: Observed rows and query treatment grid; randomized context/query pretraining split.
label_compute_budgets: Frozen inference; scenario benchmark has8 validation and6 test scenarios.
limitations: Back-door continuous-dose setting; does not validate binary-event top-decile policy optimization.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: context must preserve treatment-range support; binary arm balancing does not transfer directly.

title: IV-ICL: Bounding Causal Effects with Instrumental Variables via In-Context Learning
authors: Vahid Balazadeh, Hamidreza Kamkari, Medha Barath, Ricardo Silva, Rahul G. Krishnan
specific_claims: Learns causal-effect posterior under IV partial identification and derives bounds from quantiles.
context_mechanism: Observational IV dataset supplied to an amortized Bayesian estimator.
label_compute_budgets: Synthetic pretraining; reported inference comparisons20–500 times faster.
limitations: Bounds are not point-identified uplift scores; IV assumptions and prior sensitivity remain relevant.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: demonstrates importance of estimand-specific context, not a competing row selector.

title: A Causal Foundation Model for Structure and Outcome Prediction
authors: Max Zhu, Martino Mansoldo, Ching-Hao Wang, Stefan Groha
venue_status: ICML2026 Foundation Models for Structured Data workshop; model TabPFN-CFM
specific_claims: Joint causal-structure and outcome prediction, optionally conditioned on supplied graph information.
context_mechanism: Observed tabular context; observational, interventional, or counterfactual query type.
label_compute_budgets: Synthetic SEM supervision; evaluated fit-sample budgets32,256,1024.
limitations: Graph/outcome prediction metrics do not establish budget-constrained uplift-policy performance.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: structural information is another adaptation axis, separate from selecting labeled memory.

title: Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Causal Inference: a Simulation Study with Real-World Scenarios
authors: Francisco Mourao, David Hajage, Daria Bystrova, Bertrand Bouvarel, Nathanaël Lapidus, Fabrice Carrat, Benjamin Glemain
venue_status: Preprint; later journal status not verified
specific_claims: Reports biased binary-treatment/binary-outcome ATE estimation and poor CausalPFN interval coverage in two simulated clinical scenarios.
context_mechanism: Standard estimator use; not context selection.
label_compute_budgets: Simulation replications; TabPFN uncertainty requires repeated bootstrap fitting.
limitations: ATE scope; calibration configuration requires careful interpretation.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: uncertainty-driven selectors need external calibration checks.
evidence_sections: Methods: causal setting, estimators; Results; Discussion

title: Unit-level aggregation breaks coverage in causal foundation models
authors: Gabe Schulman, Lucius E. J. Bynum, Yoav Wald
specific_claims: Independent aggregation of unit-level predictions misses shared-SCM covariance; joint neural-process heads improve group-effect coverage.
context_mechanism: Joint group prediction heads on a frozen CausalPFN; not row retrieval.
label_compute_budgets: Six benchmarks; existing backbone weights retained.
limitations: Improved coverage is not always nominal; no uplift-policy selector demonstrated.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: per-query uncertainty cannot automatically price context value for a whole policy.
evidence_sections: Sections4–5; AppendixE; source pinned CausalPFN commit7da4afa

title: Frequentist Consistency of Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Causal Inference
authors: Valentyn Melnychuk, Vahid Balazadeh, Stefan Feuerriegel, Rahul G. Krishnan
specific_claims: Studies prior-induced confounding bias and develops one-step posterior correction with martingale nuisance posteriors.
context_mechanism: Posterior correction atop PFNs; not support-row optimization.
label_compute_budgets: Adds posterior-sampling/correction work to ordinary PFN inference.
limitations: ATE frequentist guarantees require stated nuisance/concentration conditions; not general CATE-policy guarantees.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: orthogonal correction itself is prior art and cannot be claimed as a new context method.

title: Unveiling Prior-Data Fitted Networks on Causal Effect Estimation: Pre-Training or Fine-Tuning?
authors: Haotian Wang, Xinpeng Lv, Hao Zou, Yanghao Xiao, Shanzhi Gu, Yang Shi, Yunxin Mao, Yuanxing Zhang, Mingyang Geng, Shaowu Yang, Haoxuan Li, Wenjing Yang, Peng Cui, Zhouchen Lin
specific_claims: Authors identify prior uncoverage and propose point-wise interventional fine-tuning and budgeted meta-sampling fine-tuning.
context_mechanism: Target-specific weight adaptation, not frozen labeled-memory selection.
label_compute_budgets: Budgeted active-learning framing; exact budget not verified from full text.
limitations: Full-PDF retrieval failed; theorem scope and required interventional access remain unverified.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: closest modern competing adaptation direction; abstract cannot establish that all frozen selectors must fail.
evidence_sections: Official proceedings abstract only; PDF access failed

title: Towards Causal Foundation Model: on Duality between Optimal Balancing and Attention
authors: Jiaqi Zhang, Joel Jennings, Agrin Hilmkil, Nick Pawlowski, Cheng Zhang, Chao Ma
version: ICML2024 proceedings; arXiv v3 retains earlier title wording
code_status: Paper link; current accessibility not established; official-repository issue113 reports missing directory
specific_claims: Relates optimal covariate balancing to self-attention and learns causal estimation across unlabeled datasets.
context_mechanism: Attention-derived balancing weights; not discrete K-row retrieval.
label_compute_budgets: Meta-training precedes zero-shot inference on new datasets.
limitations: Attention/balancing theory does not itself provide a fixed-budget uplift selector.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: causal attention and learned balancing are already established ingredients.

title: Black Box Causal Inference: Effect Estimation via Meta Prediction
authors: Lucius E. J. Bynum, Aahlad Manas Puli, Diego Herrero-Quevedo, Nhi Nguyen, Carlos Fernandez-Granda, Kyunghyun Cho, Rajesh Ranganath
venue_status: Preprint; TMLR submission located, acceptance not established
specific_claims: Learns dataset-to-estimand prediction from simulated dataset/effect pairs across several identification settings.
context_mechanism: Permutation-invariant dataset representation; meta-prediction rather than PFN-specific retrieval.
label_compute_budgets: Synthetic estimand labels; deployment reuses trained estimator.
limitations: Performance depends on generating-family alignment; general uplift-memory scalability is not demonstrated.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: learning causal estimators across tasks predates the current PFN generation.

title: Zero-shot causal learning
authors: Hamed Nilforoshan, Michael Moor, Yusuf Roohani, Yining Chen, Anja Šurina, Michihiro Yasunaga, Sara Oblak, Jure Leskovec
specific_claims: Predicts effects of novel interventions using intervention descriptors and individual features.
context_mechanism: Across-intervention meta-model with estimated pseudo-outcomes; not per-query donor retrieval.
label_compute_budgets: Many intervention tasks supply training information; unseen interventions require no outcome history.
limitations: Intervention-description transfer differs from adapting to a new tabular dataset with labeled support.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: causal meta-learning and pseudo-outcome supervision alone are not new.

title: Meta-learning for heterogeneous treatment effect estimation with closed-form solvers
authors: Tomoharu Iwata, Yoichi Chikahara
version: arXiv v1; journal publication verified on author institution site
specific_claims: Learns task-shared representations and differentiable closed-form task-specific CATE adaptation.
context_mechanism: Few-shot support set drives analytic adaptation; large-data estimated CATE supervises meta-training.
label_compute_budgets: Multiple data-rich tasks for training; few observed samples at deployment.
limitations: Requires related tasks; not frozen-FM row selection or a true-CATE-free guarantee for all tasks.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: teacher-CATE meta-supervision is prior art.

title: Budgeted Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Estimation
authors: Tian Qin, Tian-Zuo Wang, Zhi-Hua Zhou
specific_claims: Bounds PEHE using covering radius, fitted losses and arm-distribution discrepancy; selects informative outcome queries.
context_mechanism: Arm-aware coreset in a learned representation, followed by outcome acquisition and estimator training.
label_compute_budgets: Budget B counts queried factual outcomes; iterative refitting.
limitations: Previously unobserved labels and changing model differ from selecting already-labeled frozen-FM memory.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: causal coreset selection is established prior art.

title: Causal-BALD: Deep Bayesian Active Learning of Outcomes to Infer Treatment-Effects from Observational Data
authors: Andrew Jesson, Panagiotis Tigas, Joost van Amersfoort, Andreas Kirsch, Uri Shalit, Yarin Gal
specific_claims: Information-theoretic acquisition accounts for overlap rather than maximizing factual uncertainty alone.
context_mechanism: Queries unknown outcomes from an X,T pool; retrains Bayesian CATE estimator.
label_compute_budgets: Warm-start plus sequential outcome-label acquisition; fixed observed treatment.
limitations: Acquisition cannot manufacture overlap absent from the pool.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: uncertainty plus arm support is not an original selection criterion.

title: Progressive Generalization Risk Reduction for Data-Efficient Causal Effect Estimation
authors: Hechuan Wen, Tong Chen, Guanhua Ye, Li Kheng Chai, Shazia Sadiq, Hongzhi Yin
version: arXiv v1; accepted KDD2025 per author manuscript
specific_claims: Acquisition progressively reduces model uncertainty and treated/control distribution discrepancy.
context_mechanism: Model-agnostic geometric batch selection, including paired acquisition across arms.
label_compute_budgets: New factual outcomes are acquired under a labeling budget; estimator retrained.
limitations: Paired querying restricts flexibility when one arm alone would be informative.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: paired donor geometry and diversity/balance objectives need comparison against this lineage.

title: Enhancing Treatment Effect Estimation via Active Learning: A Counterfactual Covering Perspective
authors: Hechuan Wen, Tong Chen, Mingming Gong, Li Kheng Chai, Shazia Sadiq, Hongzhi Yin
version: arXiv v1; ICML2025 accepted author manuscript
specific_claims: Uses factual and counterfactual covering radii in treatment-effect risk bounds and coverage-maximizing acquisition.
context_mechanism: Greedy geometry-driven selection from observed-X,T/unobserved-Y pool.
label_compute_budgets: Outcome-query budget, with CATE-estimator fitting after acquisition.
limitations: Bounds require stated smoothness/coverage conditions; no frozen-PFN context-memory theorem.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: effect-aware geometric coverage is a strong competing design, not an empty novelty space.

title: Causal-EPIG: Causally Aligned Active CATE Estimation
authors: Erdun Gao, Jake Fawkes, Dino Sejdinovic
preprint_title: Causal-EPIG: A Prediction-Oriented Active Learning Framework for CATE Estimation
version: ICML2026 final abstract plus arXiv v1 methods
specific_claims: Targets expected uncertainty reduction in joint potential outcomes or CATE over a chosen target distribution.
context_mechanism: Predictive information gain scores unknown-outcome candidates; Bayesian estimator retrained after acquisition.
label_compute_budgets: Label budget nB, warm-start and acquisition batches; target covariates available.
limitations: Preferred objective depends on estimator/effect structure; tested information gain is not policy-value gain.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: causal objective alignment is explicit prior art.
evidence_sections: PreprintSections2.1, 3–4; equation5; Algorithm1; final proceedings abstract

title: Sample Constrained Treatment Effect Estimation
authors: Raghavendra Addanki, David Arbour, Tung Mai, Cameron Musco, Anup Rao
specific_claims: Jointly chooses experimental subjects and treatment assignment using leverage sampling/discrepancy ideas under linear effects.
context_mechanism: Experimental design, not selection of already-observed factual rows.
label_compute_budgets: Only s of n people may enter the experiment; outcomes then observed.
limitations: Guarantees rely on linear-effect assumptions; treatment is controllable.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: contrast-optimal sample design predates causal-PFN retrieval; adaptation requires different assumptions.

title: Active Adaptive Experimental Design for Treatment Effect Estimation with Covariate Choices
authors: Masahiro Kato, Akihiro Oga, Wataru Komatsubara, Ryo Inokuchi
specific_claims: Optimizes covariate sampling density and propensity jointly to minimize an ATE efficiency bound.
context_mechanism: Sequentially selects units and assigns treatment, then observes outcomes.
label_compute_budgets: Sequential experiment budget; AIPW plus importance-sampling estimation.
limitations: ATE variance objective and controllable enrollment differ from CATE ranking with fixed historical donors.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: variance-optimal sampling has established statistical theory; PFN-specific policy claims need additional work.

title: Improving Treatment Effect Estimation with LLM-Based Data Augmentation
authors: Nicolas Huynh, Julianna Piskorz, Jeroen Berrevoets, Max Ruiz Luyten, Mihaela van der Schaar
version: Author workshop manuscript; exact revision date not established
venue_status: ICML2025 Foundation Models for Structured Data workshop, verified on author page; not main conference
evidence_access_note: Indexed primary-PDF method/AppendixF.10 excerpts examined; direct OpenReview PDF/attachment blocked by browser challenge.
specific_claims: GATE augments downstream CATE training with pretrained-generative-model counterfactual outcomes.
context_mechanism: Few-shot observational prompts; opposite-arm kNN versus random prompt selection ablation.
label_compute_budgets: AppendixF.10 uses K50 neighbors; generated labels and downstream fitting add cost.
limitations: Generated outcomes and imputed counterfactual evaluation differ from factual-row-only retrieval.
novelty_relevance: Our assessment: direct adjacent prior for choosing causal-LLM demonstrations, not frozen causal-PFN memory.
evidence_sections: Primary PDF indexed methods and AppendixF.10; author publication list59–62
